Preconditions: Waybill draft then approved waybill with pricing authority
Action_or_Steps: Set draft charge lines then approve then attempt silent change then controlled amendment with reason
Expected_Result: Draft NetAmount derives from charge lines;silent approved edit is rejected;authorized amendment creates audited correction
Offline_Audit: Online;before-after reason and financial impact audited

Scenario: اعتماد استلام وصول مع سطر غير محقق
Preconditions: Arrival receipt has expected manifest lines and at least one unvalidated actual line
Action_or_Steps: Attempt FinalizeArrivalReceipt then validate all lines/evidence and retry
Expected_Result: First attempt fails UNVALIDATED_LINES;second finalizes receipt while waybill remains partial if quantities remain in transit
Offline_Audit: Online finalization;expected actual evidence and finalizer audited

Scenario: إغلاق رحلة وبها حمولة غير محسومة
Preconditions: Trip ARRIVED with one manifest quantity still in open custody
Action_or_Steps: Attempt CloseTrip then account remaining cargo by arrival transfer return or approved exception and retry
Expected_Result: First attempt fails CARGO_UNACCOUNTED/CUSTODY_OPEN;second closes trip
Offline_Audit: Online;custody reconciliation snapshot and close actor audited

Scenario: إشعار وصول العميل مع إعادة المحاولة
Preconditions: Eligible arrival event and receiver contact exist
Action_or_Steps: Send notification twice with same ClientOperationId then simulate provider failure for another event and retry
Expected_Result: Same logical notification is not duplicated;failed notification retains attempt history and can retry to SENT
Offline_Audit: Online;masked destination provider result attempt count and idempotency audited

Scenario: حل مطالبة فقد دون تغيير سجل الحركة
Preconditions: LOSS exception open with evidence and accepted movement history
Action_or_Steps: Resolve exception with required resolution then inspect movement timeline
Expected_Result: Exception resolves/closes while original movement events remain unchanged and drillable
Offline_Audit: Online resolution;before-after resolution and evidence audited
